feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 7 (y=0.06, ±0.055) scored 50.25 with 0.9 line losses per trial on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom, and iteration 6 (y=0.06, ±0.05) scored 51.67 with one loss on each of those tracks. Iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) had zero losses but progress of only 0.040 on s-bend. So span is not the cause of the losses (iteration 7 changed span with no effect on losses), and the forward row is the source. I kept the iteration 7 controller unchanged, so the result isolates the row position. If line losses clear at y=0.045 and s-bend progress stays above 0.04, keep this row and test sensor_size 0.012 at this row to see whether the oval floor (0.060 to 0.063 in every design so far) moves. If losses persist at y=0.045, the controller's base_speed is the lever (the Integrator will drop it), and the geometry should stay at this row. If s-bend progress falls below 0.04 with no losses, the row is too close to the axle, so move forward to y=0.05 next, which iteration 0 suggested but with a different footprint and span.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall to 0 on s-bend and slalom at y=0.045 and s-bend progress stays above 0.04, keep this row and set sensor_size to 0.012 at y=0.045, because the oval max_error has stayed at 0.060 to 0.063 across every geometry change and the footprint has not been isolated at a forward row.

If line losses persist at y=0.045 with ±0.055, keep the geometry unchanged and let the Integrator reduce base_speed, because losses appeared at y=0.06 (iteration 7) with the same span and not at y=0.03 (iteration 5), pointing to curve speed rather than sensing.

If s-bend progress falls below 0.04 with no losses at y=0.045, move the row to y=0.05 with ±0.055, because iteration 5 (y=0.03) gave progress 0.040 and iteration 6 (y=0.06) gave 0.157, so the lookahead between those rows should recover some progress.
